title: Bug:platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py is failing with `exceptiongroup.ExceptionGroup: errors while tearing down` in 202505
author: rajkumar1-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

multiple test cases from platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py are failing with `exceptiongroup.ExceptionGroup: errors while tearing down`.

Its happening due to current memory utitilization checks are taking longer time that leads
to watchdog getting triggerd before disarm.

### Steps to Reproduce

simply running the tests

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

tests should pass

linkedPullRequests.title: Disable memory utilization checks for `platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py`
linkedPullRequests.author: rajkumar1-arista
linkedPullRequests.body:
Current memory utilization checks are taking longer time that leads to watchdog getting triggered before disarm.
since all tests in `platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py` focuses on precision of watchdog timeout , its better to disable memory utilization check for these tests
